issues.issue: Did the claimant prove a serious possibility of persecution if returned to Mexico?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges persecution by Mara Salvatrucha gang members.
issues.respondent_position: No nexus to a Convention ground; no state involvement; claim rejected under IRPA 96 and 97(1)(a).
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to prove serious possibility of persecution; claim rejected.

issues.issue: Is the claimant a person in need of protection under IRPA 97(1)(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears Mara Salvatrucha and cannot safely relocate within Mexico.
issues.respondent_position: Claimant was victim of generalized crime; safe internal flight alternatives exist; fears are implausible.
issues.result_text: Claimant and family not persons in need of protection; internal flight alternative exists.

issues.issue: Is the internal flight alternative to Yucatán or Zacatecas reasonable and available to the claimant?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears Mara Salvatrucha and cannot relocate safely within Mexico.
issues.respondent_position: Burden on claimant to prove unreasonableness; claimant failed to meet burden; relocation reasonable.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to prove internal flight alternative unreasonable; relocation expected.
